CustomField.description: Selects who is set as the owner of records created during conversion: User (the running/submitting user), Template Owner (the Form Template's owner), or Campaign Owner (owner of the related Campaign). The convert Flows read this to stamp ownership on created Accounts/Contacts/Leads/etc.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose who owns the records this form creates on conversion: the submitting User, the Template Owner, or the Campaign Owner. Pick the one that matches how your team triages new records.
CustomField.label: Default Owner
